composer-2.5-fast.concept: Wire a circuit board before the 13ms verification window closes — drag between nodes to complete paths while an agent scanner sweeps your board.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: each completed circuit unlocks one more component to wire before the next scan
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: verification windows shrink and extra nodes spawn mid-round
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: neon schematic traces on matte black PCB

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Hold and release water drops onto embers spreading across a parched hillside — arc each drop before heat waves accelerate the flames.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: clearing a zone reveals a hidden home worth saving in the final seconds
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: wind gusts bend arcs and embers multiply in clusters
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: watercolor smoke over amber summer hills

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Swipe falling query blocks into duck-shaped ponds or SQL-shaped pools before they stack — wrong sorts corrupt the pile.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: three clean matches in a row chain into a satisfying stack collapse
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: blocks fall faster and decoy shapes mimic both pools

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Tap in rhythm as aftershock ripples pulse across a seismograph — match each tremor pattern before the next wave arrives.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: perfect streaks flatten the graph line into calm for a breath
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: overlapping wave frequencies add false peaks to dodge
